purpose: Operational crosswalk over existing source, not a replacement implementation or a claim of complete test coverage.

rules.statement: One actual individual/event per row; handling is CAPTURES, an independent observation is RESIGHTINGS, hiding photos need separate H rows. Do not fabricate companions or erase observations.
Metal ring and reliable individual mark history establish identity; shared chick colours do not distinguish siblings. Current nesting associations require current evidence, never an archive nest ID.

Preserve partial/question-mark observations. They cannot supply definitive parent evidence unless a verified ring traces capture identity by the event date; nonblank ring text alone is insufficient. X/XX unbanded observation is not an individual cross-nest key.

Family inference shares field date/site/exact GPS pair and rejects conflicting explicit nest IDs across CAPTURES and RESIGHTINGS. Direct nest, deterministic prior ring history and valid ordinary family GPS routes remain distinct; ambiguous events remain unresolved.

Negative IDs identify broods of unknown origin and belong only in CAPTURES/RESIGHTINGS. Unrelated adult captures use NULL nest_id with direct GPS. NO_NEST is retired. New H rows require explicit valid positive/negative ID, ring, GPS and photo fields; historical blank-H compatibility does not waive entry rules.

Keep selected identity, evidence count, ambiguity, pending association, capture-method provenance and visible mark separate. Definitive TN and qualifying IN/NM/SC/BW/BC/FC/AC evidence resolve eligible association; AT alone and MM alone do not. Eligible pre-MM evidence counts for reliably identified same-nest birds and later MM does not reset earned proof. Approved by Luke on 2026-11-01: an unambiguous confirming X-X resighting and exactly one eligible capture_status F first-banding captured identity of the same sex, nest and date are assumed the targeted same individual. Transfer that same-day confirmation without later proof, including MM. first_marking_counts counts all distinct eligible F capture identity keys at that nest/sex/date BEFORE later-proof or ambiguity filters; multiple identities cannot be filtered into fake uniqueness. Same-day linkage requires a unique replacement and unambiguous confirming resighting r. Preserve the date; infer no exact observed time/order; linked proof is conservatively dated at capture datetime. Earlier different-day X-X proof cannot transfer: the new identity needs its own one confirming or three distinct eligible postcapture observations; its own valid same-day confirming linkage can now retire older placeholders without transferring older proof. No unique link with competing captured identities, ambiguous/ineligible evidence, other sex/nest, recapture only or evidence beyond reference. Later X-X stays separate. Preserve original X-X displacement history, independent proof and conflicting strong evidence under existing hierarchy/ambiguity rules; no nonconfirming-count revival of displaced MM-only identities. Seven-day/36-hour/tag gates and unrelated same-day juvenile-origin/brood-closure safeguards are unchanged. See PARENT_ASSOCIATION_CHRONOLOGY.md and parent-association-cases.json; focused synthetic verification is recorded in SAME_DAY_LINKAGE_VERIFICATION_2026-11-01.md. Each sex resolves independently.

A resolved note requires authoritative resolution plus a visible non-sentinel mark. A selected key or one observed identity is insufficient. Selected-individual death removes that target, not a living mate or siblings.

Capture waits seven days from the final egg completion basis. Stable two-egg clutches need three-day confirmation; use final-egg laying/valid float estimate or conservative observed proxy, not confirmation date. A later third egg resets the basis. Discovery alone and a visit gap are not completion. Preserve separate hatch/negative-brood exceptions.

A target parent must independently satisfy the 36-hour disturbance rule using the reference date at 08:00 and relevant prior parent capture time. Pair completion does not waive timing. Closed gates give resighting-only instructions.

Flagging tasks and PDF N chicks/N seen share the SQL latest qualifying encounter and corresponding active flag count, bounded by reference date. Distinct known chicks count once. Unknown, unringed, ambiguous or dead identities retain conservative handling; unavailable encounter uses documented operational fallback, not a separate R encounter definition.

Distinct qualifying H-photo chick rings resolve hiding-photo progress against captured chick identities; duplicate same-ring photos count once and no captured-ring baseline remains open in the task window. Tent photographs stay on captures; H photographs stay on sightings.

Qualifying same-parent renesting/associated scrape and later non-brood behaviour follow separate chronology and live-evidence safeguards. Do not backdate closure from a future confirmation or confuse a closed nest site with brood death.

From day36 presume loss only if no qualifying live brood encounter during ages21-35 inclusive; the window is fixed. Use established negative-brood age/discovery proxy where needed. Later live evidence reopens eligible work, and late-uploaded in-window evidence prevents this route. Suppress related parent tasks/summary while retaining independent positive-nest notA obligations.

One reliable origin-linked age-J event, including D recovery, resolves original chick-stage work under this study's developmental assumption. An age-C death does not do that; living siblings remain independent. Individual death is not whole-brood loss.

Late-wave initial tagging uses eligible positive B/C nests with completion strictly after2026-10-09. B/unknown and unknown/B can say tag any, but only if one is confirmed X-X. Confirm unknown as X-X and nest-associated first; if banded no initial deployment under that instruction. Existing both-unknown case remains. Do not change task selection or chronology to obtain a tag.

Pair completion requires qualifying current-nest deployment provenance and an eligible mate. A unique pending identity's own GEO evidence suppresses another tag while retaining association-resighting work. Never promote association to resolve task wording. Tag-bearing unknown-mate notes use pair completion symmetrically.

A Parent capture row with a note containing tag gives the existing map point a white outline; a timing-blocked Parent resighting row does not qualify merely because its note mentions tag. Highlighting is not permission to deploy. Summary/map/PDF consume published task meanings and retain invalid-ID/empty-plot handling.

Build bounded inputs and tasks before atomic publication under cooperative schema-refresh lock. Latest succeeded status, dates, helper routing and exact TODO/snapshot equality are required. Failure stops rendering; an older succeeded row cannot validate a newer failed/running build.

notA_summary is installed once after initial snapshot. One latest-notA nest row includes both sexes and separate pending details; later links require reliable confirmed same-sex identity at both nests and strictly later discovery. X-X/shared colours cannot link. New successful publications update it; stale/failed latest state hides rows.

Use x and rowid/variable/reason validator contract. Hard vs warn is selected by final word of inspectors.comments with table_name unchanged; export suffixes are not row table names. Keep mock_generation_only out of live validation. Registered internal observers accept2-3uppercase letters/digits; public attribution remains free text.
